summary: Swann Road kerb with townhouses 5-12 m away and a steep grade.

best_section.where: South kerb of Swann Road opposite the townhouse block

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings within 5-12 m along the whole stretch; no gap to avoid them.
drivers.access_and_room: Cars already park along this kerb, so a van fits.
drivers.traffic: Busy through road with a junction at the far end.
drivers.convention: Other cars park here, but homes are too close for an overnight stay.

sun_shade: Trees along the north side give patchy shade; open otherwise.
